title: Why Malaysia Won’t Extradite Dr. Zakir Naik to India
author: Asif Ullah Khan
text:
Dr. Zakir Naik, as seen in a screenshot of a video posted to his YouTube channel on Aug. 22, 2025.
Credit: Screenshot by The Diplomat
The biggest viral video of the recently concluded BRICS Summit in New Delhi was not of Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi shaking hands with Chinese President Xi Jinping, but of Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim singing a Hindi film song.At a gala dinner during the summit, Anwar spotted a pianist in the hotel lobby and started singing Kishore Kumar’s evergreen “Khwaab Ho Tum Ya Koi Haqeeqat” from the 1965 Dev Anand film, “Teen Deviyan.” Indian movies are very popular in Malaysia, and Anwar must have grown up listening to Bollywood songs because he has sung this song many times on past visits to India.[...]
